expected.title: Unique minimum-area Reuleaux polygons of prescribed unit width and inradius below one half
expected.author: Antoine Henrot; Ilaria Lucardesi
expected.difficulty_reason: A fixed-inradius constraint prevents the usual unconstrained Blaschke deformation argument from identifying the area minimiser directly. The author proves rigidity of the admissible clusters, derives their exact area formula and strict interior concavity, and uses the constrained arc-count optimisation to exclude competing polygon configurations. This geometric reduction and analytic sign construction establish the unique polygon optimiser without relying on the separate density claim for arbitrary constant-width bodies.
